prompt: Explain a bounded work queue and backpressure in three concise paragraphs. Give one example involving a web server.
Write a small Python function that splits newline-delimited input chunks into complete lines, retaining an incomplete final line. Explain two edge cases.

Propose an experiment comparing two inference servers. Cover warmup, identical prompts, concurrency, error counts, token usage and the limits of a small sample.
